name: Lantern-pattern Squad Drone Kit (SD-1 Wisp, SD-2 Tick, SD-C cradle)
revision: 0.1 · resin drone kit: 2 flying Wisps, landed Wisp, Tick + 3 weapon modules, cradle + pack saddle, stems, 32 mm bases
description: The Lantern kit every Vigil fireteam carries: the SD-1 Wisp ducted quadcopter (recon, or designator and munition, plus a landed marker), the SD-2 Tick tracked crawler with a periscope mast and swappable Talon carbine, mine-plough or relay-and-smoke modules, and the SD-C cradle that clips a folded Wisp behind a trooper's spine pack.

images.label: 3/4 front: Wisp A on its raked stem, Tick A (render)
Wisp A, B and landed: 3/4, front, side, top
Tick with modules A, B, C: 3/4, front, side, top
SD-C cradle on the line power pack (pack not in this kit)

buildNotes: Wisp: one piece (chevron body, four 0.85 mm-wall ducts, rotors recessed 0.4 mm, chin ball with split-chevron lenses); round 1.8 mm stem socket under the body.
Flight stem: printed 1.6 mm resin, or cut a 1.6 mm clear acrylic rod to 27 mm; it seats 3 mm into the raked base socket and 2 mm into the Wisp.
Tick: hull and tracks in one piece; the periscope mast (1.2 mm D-flat peg) and one weapon module (1.6 mm D-flat peg) plug into the deck.

SD-C: glue the pack saddle over the top and back of a line-standard power pack; the cradle (folded Wisp) plugs into the saddle on the standard 2.0 mm D-flat pack peg, or straight into a figure's pack socket.
Every part prints on supports in the orientation miniature_support_plan picked (print/stl is already in that pose).
limitations: Procedural SDF sculpt, not a hand sculpt. Printability is a heuristic screen through unified-CAD-MCP, not a test print; print a tolerance coupon for the 0.1 mm glue fits. No STEP: FreeCAD is not installed on the build host, so cad/ holds no assembly STEP (recorded as skipped).

mini.base: 32 mm round x 3 mm, 5 x 2 mm magnet pocket vented to the rim; stem bases carry a 24 deg raked 1.8 mm stem socket
mini.process: MSLA resin · 8K 7-inch class MSLA (e.g. Elegoo Saturn/Mars class)

printability.summary: 13 print files checked in their print pose; no fail-severity findings.
